component: Thunderbird Address Book list and table layout

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The #cards rule supplies the top border in both layouts. Only rows=ab-card-row receives 2 px block padding. The actual layout toggle selects ab-table-card-row for table mode, so that padding rule is limited to list rows. The same patch supplies explicit sidebar color defaults before their aliases. These are selector and token contracts; no visual or contrast result was measured.
title: Address Book table rows avoid the card-list block padding
